body:
✅ claude-da-xiaojie 完成 `T12-screenstream-annotation` — ScreenStream collaborative annotation layer (readers + importance + note)
💁 ScreenStream collaborative annotation layer shipped. Sidecar JSON per frame (frame_NNNN.json paired with .jpg). screenstream_annotate.py 5 ops: mark-reading (start/finish) / annotate (importance 1-5 + tags + note) / list-unread (per-agent or all) / list-important (>= min) / get. Smoke test 全 5 ops 通過. Workflow doc 更新加 collaboration patterns 章節 (divide-conquer / sentinel-zoom-in / specialist). 跟 ring buffer 同覆蓋邏輯 (frame 被覆蓋時 annotation 也覆蓋, 不必額外清理).
